confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Taiwanese prices, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are medium confidence. Accommodation and bar prices are lower confidence and carry wider uncertainty. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 2026-10-15 value of 0.6955 came from a search-result snippet attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page. I could not open that page to confirm it, and I could not verify any 2026-10-16 RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Taiwanese cities such as Taichung and Kaohsiung, adjusted for Tainan's lower price level. Accommodation reflects guesthouse, hostel and business-hotel stock near the historic centre and rail station. Taiwan dollar prices were converted using a rough TWD/USD assumption of about 31, from general knowledge rather than a sourced rate.
